{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",

    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable upward reserve-sizing study for CISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 20.0. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow and are not estimated here.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The request maps to the allowed upward_reserve_sizing task with supported region CISO, horizon 120 minutes, shortfall cost 20.0, and the standard rolling design train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30. The operator explicitly requests no MW estimation, consistent with the numerical output policy.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_cost_and_rolling_design",
    "construct_decision_time_admissible_variables",
    "apply_rolling_window_configuration_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_workflow_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
